title: Concept: Report-To names a plaintext endpoint
description: The Report-To header lists a plaintext endpoint. Reports describe blocked requests, network errors and other events tied to the user’s session, and they are posted by the browser to the named URL; over http:// those reports and their metadata are readable on the path.
applicability: Responses that configure the Reporting API.
risk: Session-linked event reports readable in transit; LOW severity because report bodies are diagnostic rather than credential-bearing.
